notes.title: A Journey to Uncover the Supernatural Mysteries in the Dreamy Heart of Da Lat
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44712068/491588e5fe055b9de70d924dcb865b3779f5ae73.png[/img]
[h2][b]Exciting Plot[/b][/h2]
Set in the dreamy city of Đa Lat in the early 2000s, Taken Soul immerses players in the role of Trung, a young man vacationing there with his family. Tragedy strikes when his mother and sister mysteriously disappear. Trung is compelled to embark on a journey to find and rescue them, facing supernatural forces and uncovering dark secrets hidden deep within the city.

[h2][b]Authentic Da Lat Setting[/b][/h2]
Taken Soul utilizes modern technology to vividly and accurately recreate Da Lat down to the finest details. From famous landmarks such as Da Lat Railway Station, Xuan Huong Lake, to winding slopes and ancient houses, everything is portrayed with an eerie and mystical aura.

[h2][b]Third-Person Gameplay[/b][/h2]
With a third-person perspective, players have the freedom to explore the spooky world of "Taken Soul," from dark corners to moss-covered abandoned houses. Each location contains its own mysteries and challenges, requiring players to think and solve problems to progress further in their quest.

[h2][b]Moth – A Guiding and Protective Totem:[/b][/h2]
The moth plays a significant role in "Taken Soul," symbolizing the souls of the deceased, guiding and protecting Trung on his quest for the truth. The light and shadows of the moth are meticulously simulated, creating a surreal and ghostly atmosphere.

[previewyoutube=JXwsxN6EbOA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Promoting Da Lat Culture and Tourism[/b][/h2]
Taken Soul is not just a mere entertainment game but also serves as a bridge to introduce the culture and tourism of Đà Lạt to international friends. Through dazzling images and hidden stories, players will have the opportunity to discover the mysterious and unique beauty of this dreamy city.

[h2][b]Multilingual and Translation Support:[/b][/h2]
Taken Soul supports over five international languages along with Vietnamese dubbed and subtitled versions, making it easily accessible and enjoyable for players from around the world.

Taken Soul promises to provide players with a haunting and thrilling exploration journey, intertwining reality with the spiritual, and light with darkness. Be ready to step into the spooky world of Da Lat  and decode the mysteries lurking in "Taken Soul."

notes.title: Streamers Unravel the Mysteries of Taken Soul in Engrossing Reviews
notes.notes:
[h2]#Streamers Delve Into Da Lat's Mystical Shadows
[/h2]
The recently launched adventure game "Taken Soul," set in the ethereal landscape of Da Lat's , has captivated the streaming community with its unique blend of supernatural elements and rich cultural storytelling. Here’s what some of the top streamers are saying about their eerie journey through this dreamy yet haunting city.

[h2]# Enthralling Atmosphere and Intricate Details[/h2]

Many streamers have praised "Taken Soul" for its exceptional recreation of Da Lat's , noting the meticulous attention to detail that brings the city to life. Gaming vlogger, PixelPlay, commented, "The game’s visuals are stunning. From the iconic Xuan Huong Lake to the quaint, moss-covered cottages, every scene is dripping with atmosphere that perfectly sets up the spooky vibes."

[h2]# Gameplay Dynamics and Challenges[/h2]

The third-person perspective is a hit among players, offering a comprehensive view that enhances exploration and puzzle-solving. AdventureSeeker, a popular Twitch streamer, noted, "The gameplay is immersive. Navigating through the foggy streets and solving the city's dark mysteries feels genuinely challenging and rewarding."
[previewyoutube=Wv4fQDIqBIM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]# The Supernatural and Cultural Blend
[/h2]
Streamers are particularly fascinated by the game’s integration of Vietnamese culture with supernatural folklore. CultureGamer, known for exploring cultural narratives in games, highlighted, Taken Soul does an excellent job of weaving local legends and cultural landmarks into the gameplay, making it not just a game, but a journey through Vietnamese heritage."

[h2]#The Role of the Moth Totem[/h2]

The symbolic moth totem has been a point of interest for many players, adding a unique spiritual dimension to the game. MysticalMike, a streamer who focuses on supernatural games, praised this aspect, saying, "The moth not only guides you but also adds a layer of depth to the story. It’s like your guardian angel, illuminating paths and secrets."

[h2]# Multilingual Accessibility[/h2]

The game's availability in multiple languages has been well-received, with streamers appreciating the inclusivity. GlobalPlay, a channel that showcases games from around the world, stated, "The multilingual support is fantastic. It invites a global audience to experience the game and explore Da Lat's  city mysteries, no matter where they are from."

[h2]# Conclusion[/h2]

Overall, "Taken Soul" has received overwhelmingly positive reviews from the streaming community. Its compelling storyline, atmospheric setting, and deep cultural references offer a rich gaming experience that goes beyond mere entertainment. As AdventureSeeker summed up, Taken Soul is not just a game; it's an exploration of fear, folklore, and the beauty of Da Lat's  It’s a must-play for anyone fascinated by the supernatural or the rich tapestry of Vietnamese culture."

As Taken Soul continues to enchant and terrify new players, its place in the pantheon of culturally rich narrative games seems well assured. Streamers and players alike are eager to see what mysteries they can unravel next in the shadows of Da Lat's .

notes.title: VIETNAMESE HORROR GAME TAKEN SOUL – DOAT MENH SET TO HAUNT STEAM IN MARCH
notes.notes:
[b]Taken Soul[/b] a survival horror game developed by Vietnamese studio SOGA Studio, has been scheduled for release on Steam this March.

Set in the city of Da Lat during the 2000s, renowned for its foggy landscapes and distinctive architecture, the game draws inspiration from local mythology.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44712068/915c0e5bc241f6e81f266cdfbaab0e8ba515f110.jpg[/img]

Players assume the role of Trung, who embarks on a journey to find his mysteriously vanished mother and younger sister while encountering the dark forces lurking within Da Lat. The game promises exploration of various locales, each presenting its mysteries and puzzles for players to solve.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44712068/3e261899711c32cdf51cd19db4ae30fd5d03f1e1.jpg[/img]

Trung must confront his enemies using weapons and magic, navigating through haunted houses, old train stations, and other eerie locations throughout Da Lat. The game aims to faithfully recreate the city’s iconic landmarks, such as Pine Hills, [b]Xuan Huong Lake[/b], Da Lat Station, and [b]Da Lat Pedagogical College[/b], transforming them into chilling backdrops for the horror narrative.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44712068/6953f9dd63ef9a1a5c1962880579f9128dfd8859.jpg[/img]

In addition to its visual elements,[b] Taken Soul [/b]features Vietnamese voiceovers for character dialogue scenes, enhancing the atmosphere of fear and tension.

One of its standout features is the freedom for players to shape the story and determine their ending through various decisions and interactions. Depending on player choices, the narrative unfolds in different directions, adding to the game’s replay value.
[previewyoutube=Rle-4gRNmFM;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Taken Soul  [/b]presents an intriguing blend of survival horror set against [b]Da Lat’s[/b] unfamiliar landscape. As the release date approaches, we anticipate whether the promised atmospheric horror and solid combat mechanics will deliver an engaging experience.

Buy Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2633540

notes.title: Which scenes of Da Lat City will appear in Taken Soul?
notes.notes:
Da Lat is one of the most popular tourist destinations in Vietnam, so experiencing the misty space of Da Lat, exploring mysteries, and overcoming the fear of darkness in the game itself have been the dreams of many generations of gamers. Da Lat is also known as an area for scientific research in the fields of biotechnology and nuclear physics.
Taken Soul promises to take players to visit famous locations in Da Lat, including:
[list]
[*] [b]Xuan Huong Lake:[/b] Located in the center of Da Lat city, players will lead their characters to explore around the lake, and even experience duck paddling on the lake.
[*] [b]Haunted Villas in Da Lat[/b]: Famous for numerous ghost stories, haunted villas are always a source of horror for tourists when visiting Da Lat. However, you have to overcome them to break through the chapter.
[*] [b]Da Lat Pedagogical College[/b]: Featured in the main trailer of the game, Da Lat Pedagogical College promises to be a free space for gamers to explore.
[*] [b]Da Lat Railway Station[/b]: With its ancient French architecture, Da Lat Railway Station will appear in a decisive gameplay where players must overcome their fears to continue their journey.
[*][b] Abandoned Hospital in Da Lat[/b]: Inspired by abandoned hospitals, you will have to overcome dark corridors, morgues, and many other mysterious things awaiting...
[/list]
And countless other locations are waiting for you to explore, just be brave enough. Add it to your wishlist and experience it during the Lunar New Year, dear friends.
